description: This PHP source file generates an HTML page for parental control reports, including JavaScript and PHP code to handle report generation, filtering, and display for different categories such as sites, services, devices, and aggregated reports. It includes external scripts, stylesheets, and server-side PHP includes.
published: parsing and dynamically generating report tables and filters

methods.name: ajaxDo
